entries.title: Fetch from server fills in OpenCode Go's model sizes
entries.body: A custom API connection now reads the context and output sizes OpenCode's model list states, so most models picked from the list arrive with their sizes filled in. A model whose listed output is as large as its whole context still asks for its output size. Models the server says take no chat turn, such as decision and embedding models, show Not a chat model and can't be picked, since they could never pass the check Save runs.

picture.alt: A custom API connection's model list fetched from OpenCode's list: glm-5.3 picked with its context and output sizes filled in, and decision and embedding models marked Not a chat model.
